steps.title: Create project meta-configuration
steps.description: Initialize app metadata, application name, and unique package identifier.

steps.title: Configure Gradle environment properties
steps.description: Set compiler compliance options to target Java 8 compatibility and set target SDK level 34.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest file
steps.description: Declare the package configuration, native Material theme styling, launcher activity flags, and hardware/software options.

steps.title: Design layout xml
steps.description: Design a clean, modern UI featuring centered layout components with a stylized welcome display message.

steps.title: Create string resources
steps.description: Define application name, heading title, and auxiliary welcome message descriptions as translatable strings.

steps.title: Define standard color palette
steps.description: Establish a consistent, clean color profile (backgrounds, texts, and accents) for the UI design.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity class
steps.description: Develop the primary execution activity subclassing native android.app.Activity to set up the screen layout programmatically.

steps.title: Validate resources compatibility
steps.description: Ensure the layout file does not contain external dependencies or layout elements like ConstraintLayout or AppCompat classes.

steps.title: Verify manifest architecture structure
steps.description: Check the correct configuration of launchers, package mappings, namespace directives, and theme parameters.

steps.title: Building Simple Welcome App
steps.description: Compile build resources, verify Java 8 compliance, and compile project to produce final APK artifact.
